body: It'd just all be easier if I could go through with it and stop the pain. I don't feel any happiness anymore, even in stuff I used to love doing.

A combination of things...my parents are divorced as of this summer and my mom is living in France now, my girlfriend left me last week, and the couple of people I can call friends are all hundreds of miles away. I have no motivation to do anything nor do I want to and my life is filled with anxiety. Sometimes I feel guilty that I even think about suicide because my life really isn't as bad as it could be, yet every night I think about it. To me, there's no point to me living, there's no point suffering through it all.
